game.title: Watch Dogs 2
game.blurb: Open-world hacking action-adventure from Ubisoft Montreal, released 2016-11-28. RAWG average playtime: 17 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Operations
chapters.summary: Erasing Marcus's past from the Blume servers and working through the DedSec operations to the hack of the century.

chapters.title: Extra Operations
chapters.summary: Five operations listed at the end of the list with low unlock rates: Bad Medicine, Automata, Caustic Progress, Off the Hook and Moscow Gambit.

chapters.title: Hacking and Combat
chapters.summary: Stealth takedowns, hacking robots and cars, escaping a felony and calling the cops.

chapters.title: Driving, Races and Stunts
chapters.summary: Sailboat, drone and bike races, long jumps, hijacking boats and buses, unique vehicles, dealerships and the eKart.

chapters.title: City Life and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Clothes, the 3D printer, apps, dogs, selfies, ScoutX photos, Key Data and the cable car.

chapters.title: Online Play
chapters.summary: Co-op operations, Bounty Hunter, hacker invasions and Showd0wn.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 447040)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Watch_Dogs_2
Fandom (watchdogs.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://watchdogs.fandom.com/wiki/Watch_Dogs_2
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page tagged completion stage 2, but only a Table of Contents subpage (about 250 characters) exists; Walkthrough, Gameplay and Controls are linked but not written, so it is not a real guide and no structure was taken. watchdogs.fandom.com answers the API, with about 38 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 55 Steam achievements are hidden. The data does not say which operations are main story and which are side, so all of them share one chapter; the last five operations in the schema (about 0.3 to 1.8 percent, much lower than the rest) got their own chapter and are probably add-on content, but the data does not name any DLC, so this needs checking. "One of the Gang" (5 DedSec Events) was left in city life, though it may be online. "Hack the World" (hack of the century) sits with the operations.
